events.title: Playtest is open!
events.summary: Hi everyone! Playtest is open. If anyone wants to test the game I've been developing for a while, you can send a playtest request. Feedback on the demo and subsequent stages will ensure the project launches successfully. Thanks in advance.My priorities are:Are there any general optimization issues? What FPS do you get on systems with specific specifications? How interested are you in these types of games, and what would you like to see?And overall, is it fun, and do you see potential in it?

events.title: Muhit now has a Discord server
events.summary: Just set up a Discord server for Muhit — a place to follow development more closely, see screenshots and photo mode shots as they happen, and chat with other people who are interested in the game.\JOIN TO CHANNEL]Still early days, but would genuinely love to have you there. As always, thanks to everyone who's wishlisted and followed along so far — it means a lot for a solo project.

events.title: Passed 300 wishlists — thank you!
events.summary: Just a quick note to say thanks — Muhit recently passed 300 wishlists, which honestly still feels surreal for a solo project.If you're new here: Muhit is a story-driven adventure set in an alternate 1990s Istanbul, built in a low-poly PS2-style look. Still early in development, currently working on polishing up the environments further.More updates coming soon — appreciate everyone following along so far.

events.title: Muhit was featured on AUTOMATON (Japan)!
events.summary: Excited to share that Muhit got some coverage from AUTOMATON, one of Japan's biggest gaming news sites! Link If you're new here — Muhit is a story-driven adventure set in an alternate 1990s Istanbul, low-poly PS2-style visuals, and a slow climb into the city's criminal underworld while searching for your missing family.Thanks for reading, and thank you to everyone who's wishlisted so far — it genuinely helps push the game further in Steam's algorithm.
